page_title: Ferrocast: the fast Mac launcher that also converts your files

sources.entry: Ferrocast - Fast keyboard launcher written in Rust, with clipboard history, snippets, window management and 275 local file conversions. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/drumst0ck/ferrocast) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: Ferrocast
summary.one_liner: Ferrocast is an open-source macOS keyboard launcher that also converts, compresses, crops, trims and redacts files, records the screen, keeps Markdown notes and can query local or cloud AI models.
use_cases: launch apps and files from the keyboard
convert images, audio, video or documents on a Mac
record a screen with auto zoom
ask a local Ollama model questions
summary.what_it_does: Ferrocast is a launcher opened with a hotkey (default ⌥ Space) that searches apps, commands and files in one field, with math and currency conversion on the same line. Dragging a file onto the launcher while holding Shift lets you pick a conversion; the page cites 275 conversion pairs across 46 input formats, most using macOS built-in tools with optional ffmpeg, LibreOffice and Ghostscript. It also includes clipboard history, text snippets with placeholders, about 40 window-management commands, and a screen recorder with auto zoom and transcript editing. A floating Markdown notes window and AI chat (Ollama by default, plus OpenAI-compatible servers, Anthropic API, Claude Code or ChatGPT sign-in) are built in.
notable: Open source under MIT licence, with no account and no Pro tier
File conversion and editing on-device, mostly with built-in macOS tools
Raycast-compatible Script Commands and partial support for installed Raycast extensions
Ask AI works with local Ollama by default; API keys stored in the Keychain
caveats: Apple Silicon only; Intel Macs are not supported
Needs Accessibility permission for window management, pasting and snippets; screen recording needs Screen Recording permission and macOS 14 or later
Many conversion pairs need optional tools (ffmpeg, LibreOffice, cwebp, unrar, Ghostscript) that must be installed separately
